decision.explanation: Both 'Baker Mayfield' (from D2S2/D2S4) and 'Mayfield' (from D1S4) are explicitly stated in the source texts as the winner of the 2017 Walter Camp Award. The documents confirm the event occurred in December 2017. Since both refer to the same individual and are supported by direct textual evidence without contradiction regarding the entity's identity, both full and partial name forms are preserved as valid answers.
